newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica outstrips again in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica outstrips again in thin trade.

text.p: Shares in Spain's Telefonica oustripped the indices once again on Thursday, although dealers said this did not reflect any concrete news but rather ongoing positive sentiment in thinner than usual trade.

At 1300 GMT, Telefonica was up 105 pesetas, 2.49 percent, to 4,215 while the Ibex-35 blue chip index was up 1.62 percent to 6,515.27. Around two million shares had changed hands, while the stock normally trades about five million per day.
"Every time there's flows coming into the market, Telefonica outperforms. We'll see it at 4,800 pesetas by the year-end," said a dealer at a Spanish bank.
A trader at another domestic bank saw the shares at 4,500 pesetas by year-end, but he said today's performance was explained by the fact there was "no volume at all in the market."
Dealers said the share tends to outperform as it is seen as a reliable investment option --even when the market is at highs-- on the basis of expected 20 percent annual growth.
